metadata.title: RadiKal Sector
metadata.author: Dj0z
metadata.description:
(Patching order: -Judge Blue Options above RK because it's already built-in -Forgotten Races above RK to avoid populating their stores.) Use the latest version of Hyperspace (v1.22 as of writing this)
An add-on for FTL: Multiverse v5.5.1, which adds a secret sector, multiple spicy augments (multi-ramming, extensive fire effects, special hacking, repair, internal...), including upgrades and combos! Also features a few weapons and 8 ships (7 unlockable) with specific gimmicks, and judge boons. The general theme is powerful but potentially dangerous (to you) experimental tech. More content coming soon!
****** CONTENT ******
The secret RadiKal Sector: -Weapons, augments and some other things are rarely accessible from the outside. -Get coordinates rarely during normal play or from double agents in stores, then reroute. There might be other ways too. -Original content, events, enemies, quests and specialized shops. -A player Hideout you can build over multiple runs for permanent benefits! -Danger everywhere. You might trade crew, gear, reputation or something else for even better things. Will you dare?
Resource-hungry Combat Augments: -Shipvore Ram: recklessly throw your ship at the enemy for heavy damage and repairs, risking your resources and more. Keep the risks under control with experience, or intuition! Combos with Fuel Conserver and Emergency Generator. -Offense Disabler makes the enemy harmless for a few seconds, progressively restoring their power afterwards. -Vulnerabilizer: slowly remove the enemy's defenses, with some randomness. -Plasma Teleporter: Light many fires on the enemy ship instantly! Has safe and risky deployment methods. Combos with other augments.
Other offensive Augments: -Charged Belts adds on-death damage and fire to your crew, stacking with similar effects. Has combo. -Flammabilizer: deal with fireproof and resistant enemies or eradicate vulnerable ones! -Scorch Pre-Igniter: like the original but more accessible, with flaws that the Scorch tolerate. -Weapons On Fire: great, ramping fire rate increase, but with fiery side effects.
Other defensive augments: -Persistence Shield gives Super Shields, a way to recharge them instantly, and regular shield recharge speed! -Thicker Hull can negate low damage hits, and always reduces high damage ones, with a drawback. -Arrogance Shield: high Super Shields, but reduced shield recharge rate. Also influences drones on your ship. -Punk Harmony uses a bootleg Harmony to automate and empower your Engi, scaling with Mind Control and Hacking. -Dread deck: indirectly makes your ship much deadlier to invaders while making your crew antisocials clinging to life. -Defense Kits make your crew much sturdier on your ship. -A.E.R.A. Second Wind can automatically save your ship, once per purchase.
Utility augments: -Lead Titans: make specific races stronger and heavier, maybe too much for your ship. Others get repair and movement bonuses. -Enigmashin: gamble with fleet delays through brief special hacking, maybe with consequences... -Oxygenizer: spawn an atmosphere at the start of fights. -Scorched Earth lets you set your rooms or ship on fire and benefit from it. Upgradable. Combo with Plasma Teleporter. -Surveyor: deep-search empty beacons for random loot.
Internal augments: -Calibrator: Increases the accuracy and fire rate of all of your weapons! -Choking F.I.N.E.: protects from suffocation and gives boosts while suffocating. -Demicloners: provides a semblance of cloning when your crew dies without a Clonebay. -Mind Cooler: greatly reduces the impact of having your crew mind controlled. -Hellion Wraps: in fire, your crew is combat boosted! -Mind Heater: in fire, makes your crew resist Mind Control and stun, and also reveal adjacent rooms.
Efficient weapons: -'Bada' fissure beam can deal massive damage to large systems, or blow up ships! -Three 'Heavy Popper' lasers with shield-popping superheavy projectiles, at your own risk. -'Unloader' can quickly throw your whole stock of missiles at the enemy. -'Gravespred' radiation beam can be lethal including on your ship. -'Battery Artemis' reworks the classic design to power the next weapon. -'Radiation Repair Bomb' is multi-purpose. -'Shotphaser' shotguns accelerated phase ions with high stun chance. -'Rain of Ions' shoots all kinds of ions at once! -'Chimney' missile launcher starts strong fires and sustains them with oxygen! -'Hot Poker' fireblast beam can destroy enemy systems while spreading fire all around! -'Oxygen-Bomb' refills oxygen on any ship. Can detonate for a little damage and fire. -'Rain of Fire' can eventually maintain full strength fires anywhere! -'BPS Messenger' heavy laser combines the strengths of all 3 RK subfactions.
New crew: -Vexopaths are RK Bam modified Technopaths specialized in destruction. -Uptors are made out of Alpha Gouls to fit the fiery needs of the RK Scorch. -Unique crew!
Player ships with unique gimmicks: -Embark on a wild ride with the Rammer, boasting a superior locked version of the Shipvore Ram. -The Punker plays around its massive reactor, particle accelerator, and special hacking. -The Scorcher is outfitted with what you need to burn down any enemy.
Plus a few secrets!
************ Changelog ****************** CHANGELOG RadiKal Sector v6.18c
-Improved some texts.
* Cruisers -"Titan Dropship": No longer starts with Life Support (O2). +2 missiles +5 droneparts. Added Miniship.
* Weapons -New Anti-RK missile launcher "Measure": Anti-RK Momus dealing 1 more system damage for each RK weapon on the target ship. Chains cooldown slowly but potentially a lot of times. Limited shots. Unobtainable other than from the ARKSS. -"Bada Beam": UI art scaled down a little more. Size on ship unchanged. <credit: Pepper, Cerebralcloud92, Arc>
* Sectors -Police events: The order of choices is now consistent. The drops can now also be nothing, and "Measure" (same chance for each outcome). Fixed bug where they resisted the rebel fleet. <credit: Pepper> "Quartermaster" loadout reworked. "Inquisitor" reactor power greatly increased.
Special thanks to (in no particular order) Limrix, Sequestrator of Bases and Memes, Argentum, Wooden Bench Acolyte, Mr Do, Waffle, Cerebralcloud92, dirt block, aktoja, Harmony, Fajdek, Aleev, Zuggo, LoudMute, Arc, Lizzard, codyfun, Qaser7, bamalf, Dr. Nauter, Witherbottom, Chooseche, Eschaton, Pepper, Untitled, Pupi, vertaalfout, Dalvest, Alder, Kix, [Enchanter], Pedrosian96, Royal Slime, [yenlo]R4V3-0N, robinthedragon2, Ehtya (Laythe), Blizz/mr_easy_money, Skye[NikoMaster], Julk, Felipe, marcrusian, Abstrusity and other people who helped on the FTL:MV Discord, for streaming the mod, and valuable information on balance, modding, coding and art.
